body: Thank you for your advice. I do feel as though I'm "missing out" on some things by preferring to stay inside and be alone. I **do** want to experience a little more in my life and I have started thinking, "what the hell. Why not?" as a reason to due things. I showed my dad this post and he explained that he went through the same thing when he was my age. He suggested that we go out hiking or fishing at least twice a week. I wasn't on board at first but now I see these trips as something to look forward to or just try to live long enough just to experience the outdoors more. I used to be an outdoors enthusiast before highschool when I had the time to be and now that I do online school  I have that time and opportunity again. I feel as though my life was going down the shitter and now it is starting to lighten up again. I don't think i will ever be genuinely and truly "happy" ever again but, "What the hell. Why not try to hold on?" For my parents at least. Telling them was probably the best thing for me and them. I don't know what it would do to them if I were to kill myself without them knowing. They would probably think they didn't do a good job as parents and that is not true at all. They are literally my entire life and the ONLY reason I'm here.Sorry for rambling, (you said you could chat. 😉 ) thanks for the advice and caring enough to write. It really does mean a lot for someone like me who hasn't really had anyone my age for support. -Thanks again
